title: The Suspects Are a Passionate Couple
notes: Recurring detective-cast nodes (Conan, Kogoro Mouri, Ran, Haibara, Inspector Megure) omitted by convention, as are one-off unnamed figures (Yoko's manager, an unnamed retiring teacher) and characters from the next-episode preview (Amamiya Sho & Maki) who play no role in this case. The old lower-fidelity cases/ file's stated culprit (Yamada Akimichi, s1) is CONFIRMED correct against the full transcript -- this is one of the episodes where the old summary got the culprit right. What the old file missed: it collapsed the two real forensic clues (the mismatched cigarette-butt smoking styles proving a second, hidden smoker, and the corkscrew piercing all the way through a cork the restaurant doesn't even stock) into one vague testimonial clue about wine access; it omitted the staged-presence trick's full object chain (vacuum bag of the victim's own clothes, the wine-stained pierced blanket, the sommelier knife used to pierce it, the stolen phones); and it listed no relationships beyond generic 'knows' edges, missing the real romantic/ex/classmate/employment structure (Banba was dating the victim, Konoe is her ex, Higo/Yoko/the victim were all Konan High classmates) and the three red-herring motives Kogoro floats on-screen (Konoe's smoking grudge, Banba's rumored breakup, Higo's jealousy theory) before Conan/Kogoro identify Yamada as a fake sommelier. case_type: murder.

clues.desc: Bathroom cigarette butts show two smoking styles -- some long with chewed filters, others smoked to the end -- proving two different staff members smoked there, not one.
A corkscrew never fully pierces a cheap wine's cork, but the wine-stained hole in the blanket shows Yamada's corkscrew went all the way through -- proof he isn't a real sommelier.
The stain around the blanket's hole looks like blood at a glance but smells like wine, revealing the hole was punched to fake a sleeping body, not made by violence.
